csv_project_name: Design for HATS Parking Area Pavement, Fence, & Landscaping
csv_scope_of_work: Hoke County hereby request Statements of Qualifications and Proposal for construction for a new parking area to adjoin an existing parking area located at 189 CC Steele Rd., Raeford, NC 28376. The project scope consists of parking lot design, land clearing & grading, construction, paving, fencing and landscaping to match the existing finish of the building. This also includes ensuring that appropriate design for grading is done to ensure adequate drainage. The approximate size of the parking lot is 20,000 square feet. This project will include the installation of fencing, gates, and extension of existing sidewalks to service the new parking lot.
